title: Sandglass-Shaped Ln9III Cluster Containing Two Quadrangular Pyramids (Ln5O5) Shared by Vertices: Structure, Magnetic and Photoresponsive Metal Ion Sensing

material_class.structural_family: sandglass-shaped/hourglass Ln9 cluster (two vertex-sharing Ln5O5 square pyramids)

synthesis.procedure: A ligand stock was prepared from 2.0 mmol (0.3002 g) of 2-pyridinecarboxaldehyde–ethanolamine Schiff-base ligand L dissolved in 18.00 mL anhydrous methanol and 6.00 mL acetonitrile and stirred 10 min. Dy(NO3)3·6H2O (0.2 mmol, 91.2 mg) was placed in a ~20 cm Pyrex tube, 1.2 mL of the ligand stock was added, and triethylamine (0.1 mmol, 10.1 mg) was added dropwise. The tube was shaken, frozen in liquid nitrogen, and sealed under vacuum with an oil pump. After thawing at room temperature it was heated in an oven at 80 °C for 3 days, then taken out, wrapped with cotton wool, and allowed to stand at room temperature to give pale yellow bulk crystals.

reagents.name: 2-pyridinecarboxaldehyde ethanolamine Schiff-base ligand (L)
reagents.amount: 1.2 mL of stock prepared from 2.0 mmol (0.3002 g) L in 18.00 mL MeOH + 6.00 mL MeCN (0.1 mmol per aliquot)

synthesis.time: 3 days at 80 °C, then standing at room temperature
synthesis.vessel_or_method: sealed evacuated Pyrex tube; solvothermal heating in an oven
synthesis.workup_and_crystallization: After heating, the tube was wrapped with cotton wool and stood at room temperature to precipitate pale yellow bulk crystals.

properties.summary: DC susceptibility (1000 Oe, 300–2 K) shows χmT = 124.53 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K, slightly below nine free Dy(III) ions (127.53 cm3 K mol−1), remaining nearly constant to ~50 K then falling to 30.46 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K, consistent with weak antiferromagnetic coupling and Stark-level depopulation. Isothermal magnetization at 2–5 K is unsaturated and <83 Nβ at 5 T (below 90 Nβ). Under zero DC field, AC susceptibility (1–1500 Hz, 2–14 K; 3 Oe AC) shows frequency-dependent out-of-phase χ″ and slow relaxation, i.e. SMM behavior.

measurements.name: AC susceptibility / SMM slow relaxation
measurements.value: frequency-dependent χ″ under zero DC field
measurements.conditions: 0 DC field; 3 Oe AC; 1–1500 Hz; 2–14 K (experimental section also cites 2–15 K)

properties.summary: χmT = 125.38 cm3 K mol−1 at 300 K (vs 126.63 for nine Ho(III)), falling to 46.81 cm3 K mol−1 at 2 K with overall antiferromagnetic interactions; low-T M–H curves at different temperatures do not coincide, indicating anisotropy/low-lying excited states. In DMF (1 mM), excitation at 364 nm gives an emission intensity of 595; addition of Y(III) (0.5 mM) increases intensity to 991, whereas Sm(III), Zn(II), Cr(II), Na(I), Co(II), Ni(II), Cu(II), Fe(III) and Mn(II) quench the luminescence, i.e. selective photoresponsive Y(III) sensing.
